items.title: Could Booking Holdings (BKNG) Lose Travel Search Ground To New AI Gatekeepers?
items.summary: Booking Holdings (NasdaqGS:BKNG) faces a new competitive threat after OpenAI agreed to acquire travel AI specialist Odessia. The Odessia deal gives OpenAI control of an AI trip-planning engine that sits directly between travelers and booking platforms. Travel search, trip curation and customer service are in sharper focus as investors consider how AI gatekeepers could reshape user journeys. OpenAI's move for Odessia matters, but it should be viewed alongside a wider assessment of Booking...
